posts.title: Apple fm: the odd runner
posts.description: Apple fm is the newest runner I added to ziraph, and the odd one out: it hides its token count, runs on the Neural Engine instead of the GPU, and quietly trades speed for power. Notes from wiring it in.

posts.title: On-device AI is a margin decision
posts.description: Where your inference runs is a margin, privacy, and battery decision, and every upside hinges on whether your model actually works on the user's hardware - the aspects an engineering leader should weigh before betting on on-device AI.

posts.title: Apple rebuilt its on-device AI stack at WWDC 2026
posts.description: No new chips at WWDC 2026 - but a structural rebuild of Apple's on-device AI: Core AI replaces Core ML, the matmul moved into the GPU, and the flagship cloud model runs on NVIDIA GPUs in Google Cloud.
